claim_boundary: This package transfers an explicitly completed PPGA state machine to the admitted FODE-E0 common benchmark. It is not a reproduction of the unavailable Nantong 3D terrain, wind data, objective values, or author implementation.

stage_order: conditional power-law perturbation from the second offspring generation

declared_reconstruction_controls.fitness_normalization: per-generation min-max expected power; all-equal population maps to one
declared_reconstruction_controls.diversity_distance: number of occupied sites not shared by each pair of sorted layouts
declared_reconstruction_controls.diversity_denominator: turbine_count*population_size*(population_size-1), following the literal denominator of Equation 12
declared_reconstruction_controls.stagnant_proportion: fraction of rank-aligned evaluated offspring that do not exceed the corresponding parent
declared_reconstruction_controls.feature_map: independent Bernoulli 0.8 choice between two uniformly selected distinct parents at each turbine index
declared_reconstruction_controls.mutation: independent Bernoulli 0.1 replacement by a uniformly drawn grid cell before common feasibility repair
declared_reconstruction_controls.power_law_sampler: inverse-CDF truncated x^-2.5 integer displacement on one through grid_size minus one, independent random sign, periodic boundary, then common feasibility repair
declared_reconstruction_controls.survival: best three current parents followed by the best twenty-seven evaluated offspring
declared_reconstruction_controls.physical_fes: initial thirty complete layout evaluations consume the first thirty units; every evaluated offspring consumes one unit; stop exactly at the requested work budget
declared_reconstruction_controls.randomness: counter-keyed events independent of worker scheduling

transferred_problem.case_matrix: ten joint wind scenarios crossed with 10, 20, 30, 50, and 80 turbines
transferred_problem.formal_work_if_admitted: 24000 complete feasible-layout evaluations per case and seed
transferred_problem.shared_evaluator: the same validated Jensen/Park native C++ evaluator used by every common-problem algorithm

missing: complete 3D Gaussian wake parameters and scalar oracle layouts

parallel_contract.worker_count: all processors visible to the job
parallel_stages: offspring crossover, mutation, power-law perturbation, and repair from a read-only generation
